title: Pregnancy Recipes: Iron-and-Folate Bowls You Can Cook in 30 Minutes
excerpt: Three tasty recipes pairing heme/non-heme iron with vitamin C — Vietnamese-inspired bowls with clear amounts and food-safety notes.
content:
## Introduction
During pregnancy, it's essential to consume enough iron and folate to ensure the health of both mother and baby. Iron helps create red blood cells, while folate supports the development of the fetus. In this article, we'll introduce three simple and delicious recipes that combine iron with vitamin C, helping pregnant women supplement their diet with essential nutrients.

## Nutrient Analysis
Iron and folate are two crucial nutrients during pregnancy. Iron can be found in foods like red meat, chicken, fish, and leafy green vegetables. Folate is also present in leafy green vegetables, fruits, and dairy products. Vitamin C enhances iron absorption, so combining iron with vitamin C is vital.

## Recipe 1: Grilled Chicken and Vegetable Bowl
* 100g grilled chicken
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup mixed vegetables (carrots, green beans, broccoli)
* 1 orange

Grilled chicken is an excellent source of iron, while mixed vegetables provide vitamin C and folate. The added orange will enhance iron absorption.

## Recipe 2: Grilled Fish and Salad Bowl
* 100g grilled fish
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 2 cups mixed greens salad (lettuce, tomatoes, cucumbers)
* 1 lemon

Grilled fish is a good source of iron and folate, while the mixed greens salad provides vitamin C and folate. The added lemon will enhance iron absorption.

## Recipe 3: Beef and Vegetable Stir-Fry Bowl
* 100g beef stir-fry
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup mixed vegetables (carrots, green beans, broccoli)
* 1 bell pepper

Beef stir-fry is an excellent source of iron, while mixed vegetables provide vitamin C and folate. The added bell pepper will enhance iron absorption.

## Food Safety Notes
During pregnancy, it's crucial to ensure food safety. Please note the following:
* Cook food before eating
* Avoid eating raw or undercooked food
* Wash hands and utensils before preparing food
* Store food at a suitable temperature

## Conclusion
These three recipes will help pregnant women supplement their diet with essential iron and folate, along with vitamin C to enhance iron absorption. Remember to follow food safety guidelines and consult our [meal planner](/planner) for more delicious and nutritious recipes. If you have any questions about prenatal nutrition, please visit our [prenatal nutrition category](/blog/pregnancy-nutrition) for more information.
